title: Tuscany Meadows, Harker Heights, TX - By Brian E Adams, Realtor with StarPointe Realty
description:
Tuscany Meadows is a new mid-size neighborhood in Harker Heights, located on the south side of Heights, on the corner of Chapparal Rd. and Stillhouse Lake Rd. (not far from the lake beyond).  Most of the neighborhood’s homes are larger one and two story homes between 1700 and 3500 square feet, 3 to 5 bedrooms, and some with 3 car garages.  The neighborhood features the upscale products from builders like D R Horton, Centex, and Ashton Woods. Tuscany Meadows is a great option for anyone looking for new homes, upgraded features, floorplans with extra square footage and all in Harker Heights.
